nodes.label: Backend Host ABI
nodes.rationale: Authoritative specification for the Wasm plugin host ABI, defining the contract between the server's Extism host and backend plugins. Covers host functions, plugin exports, limits, and error codes.

nodes.label: Plugin Capabilities
nodes.rationale: Capability system for backend plugins: documents (read/write), http.hosts, public-routes, notifications. Enforced at host function call time, with admin approval required for widening.

nodes.label: Circuit Breaker
nodes.rationale: Disables a plugin after 5 consecutive host-side failures (timeout, trap, pool exhaustion). Manual re-enable only. Does not count plugin's own refusals.

nodes.label: Plugin Cron
nodes.rationale: UTC, five standard fields, no overlapping executions per expression. Missed runs are skipped with a count. Dispatch on index, not clock.

nodes.label: Plugin Document Hooks
nodes.rationale: At-most-once, fire-and-forget, debounced 2s per document. Never delivered to the plugin that caused the change. Ordering per-document only.

nodes.label: Plugin Inbound Routes
nodes.rationale: Session-authenticated by default, public-routes as a capability. Rate-limited per plugin per client. Cookie/authorization stripped on the way in, set-cookie/hop-by-hop stripped on the way out.

nodes.label: Plugin KV Store
nodes.rationale: Namespaced per plugin, ungated capability. High-frequency machine state (sync cursor, ETag, last_seen). Retained on uninstall by default.

nodes.label: Plugin Config
nodes.rationale: Admin-entered configuration with secrets decrypted. Pulled, never pushed. Missing keys reported so plugin can degrade. Undeclared keys are invalid_argument.

nodes.label: Plugin Outbound HTTP
nodes.rationale: Allowlist + IP policy + address pinning. Credentials not replayed across origins. Refused by default: loopback, private, link-local, cloud metadata. Every IPv6 encoding of IPv4 re-checked.
